name: Dawn Regalia (Draknoxa signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} and acid-lime silk with a fitted bodice embroidered with {{METAL}} thorns and venom-drop motifs, a high collar of scalloped brass plates, long sleeves of sheer green gauze, and a skirt of ruffled panels and trailing ribbons that drip with glowing venom-green; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
